description: Officially, the party has warned of the “perils of AI”, but its latest campaign is at odds with this position, as is the Bengal CPI(M)’s use of AI during the 2024 Lok Sabha poll campaign.
body_lead: Weeks after warning that Artificial Intelligence technology will lead to loss of jobs and strengthen monopoly capitalism, the CPI(M) in Kerala has recreated a video message of late party leader E K Nayanar with an AI tool as part of promotions for its state conference in March. Using AI technology, the video shows Nayanar, who served as chief minister for three terms, speaking in his popular Kannur dialect and with his subtly humorous style of addressing people. The video shows “Nayanar” asking people and cadre to stand with the party and make the state conference a big success.
